definition: Bing Liu is a Chinese-American professor of computer science who specializes in data mining, machine learning, and natural language processing.
details: In 2002, he became a scholar at University of Illinois at Chicago. He holds a PhD from the University of Edinburgh (1988). His PhD advisors were Austin Tate and Kenneth Williamson Currie, and his PhD thesis was titled Reinforcement Planning for Resource Allocation and Constraint Satisfaction.

explainer.lead: Bing Liu (computer scientist) is a Chinese-American computer scientist. His work spans sentiment analysis and data mining.
explainer.knownFor: He is best known for his research on sentiment analysis (also called opinion mining), fake/deceptive opinion detection, and using association rules for prediction.

contributions.name: He developed a mathematical model that can reveal fake advertising.
He also made important contributions to learning from positive and unlabeled examples (or PU learning), Web data extraction, and interestingness in data mining.
